fees.note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-13): full-hookup sites from $55 a night or $250 a week, and from $500 a month for long stays.  Its Campspot booking page offered no sites for any date tried, October 2026 to June 2027, so call the park to book.

source: https://savannahriverrvparks.com/rates/ (daily, weekly and monthly rates; the FAQ page gives the same), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (30/50 Full Hookup RV, 30/50 Full Hookup PULLTHRU and 30 Full Hookup RV).  October and November 2026: $49.50 on a Tuesday, and the same on Saturday, October 24, which asked for 2 nights.  January and June 2027: $51.45 on a Tuesday; $56.70 on a Saturday.  The one 30-amp full-hookup site lists $38.50 for October but had no night to sell then, and a '30 Water/ Electric RV' site listed at $425-445 a night on every date read is not a nightly rate.  Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3).  Read 2026-10-13.

source: https://www.campspot.com/book/jellystone-park-cochran-ga (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30, 2027-06-08, 2027-06-12, 2 adults; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl; campspot_dates.py for every type from 2026-10-20, 2026-10-24, 2026-11-03, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30 and 2027-06-08), read 2026-10-13
